title: One SaMo
description:
As we close out 2025 and look ahead to an exciting 2026, we wanted to take a moment to highlight and recognize the hard work of our city team. 
They're the ones behind the scenes fixing buses, sweeping streets, keeping us safe, running libraries and farmers markets, and supporting our community in so many ways. 
It's because of our One SaMo team, working together with Humility, Integrity, Motivation and Care, that we're able to serve residents, businesses and visitors and cultivate and shape a resilient, inclusive, and truly livable city.
Thank you, and here's to a great new year!
